name: cell-lct
description: 在 Adobe Illustrator 当前画板中生成、重绘和续画带可编辑真实文字的科研矢量图。

interface.shortDescription: 文字可编辑的 Illustrator 科研矢量重建
interface.longDescription: 完整参考图只清理文字，保留箭头、图例、热图和原布局，路径识别后在 Master SVG 中合并可编辑文字，再通过单次缓存和单 Illustrator 连接续画。
defaultPrompt: Use $cell-lct to draw one editable scientific vector subject in the current Illustrator canvas.
Use $cell-lct to recreate the uploaded reference with live editable text in the current Illustrator canvas.
Use $cell-lct to continue drawing while preserving all existing canvas content.
